PhonePe.notes: Gatsby static page data JSON. Contains all job listings.

Cisco.notes: PhenomPeople ATS. Requires a valid CSRF token (PLAY_SESSION cookie) from initial page load.

ServiceNow.notes: PhenomPeople ATS. Blocks raw Python requests with 403 Forbidden (Cloudflare/Datadome).

SAP Labs India.notes: SuccessFactors ATS. Jobs are rendered in server-side HTML tables; no clean JSON API for unauthenticated search.

Swiggy.notes: Internal custom API or heavily obfuscated. Requires headless browser.

Freshworks.notes: Uses a mixture of factors.ai and company-target.com for tracking. Actual job list is JS-rendered.
